描述_EN: at that time fashionable noblemen wore pendant sets made up of ten or more pieces of jades of different shapes. when the owners died their pendants were buried with them. the small holes on the dragon's back and foot indicate that it was a component piece of a set. carved jade dragons or birds were worn as pendants in ancient china. this piece in the form of a curling dragon was made in the 4th century bc.
描述_ZN: 当时时尚的贵族们佩戴着由10件或更多不同形状的玉器组成的吊坠套装。 当主人死后，他们的吊坠被埋葬在一起。 龙的背部和脚上的小孔表明它是一套的组成部分。 在中国古代，雕刻的玉龙或玉鸟被作为挂件佩戴。 这个卷曲的龙形作品是在公元前4世纪制作的。
